# Palm Pizza Kitchen

> Hot stone-baked pizza, burgers, sides, drinks, and combos — delivered in Kigali, Rwanda.

Palm Pizza Kitchen (palmpizzakitchen.com) is a pizza restaurant and online ordering website based in Kigali, Rwanda. Customers browse the menu, add items to cart, and pay online for delivery or pickup.

## Quick facts

- Business: Palm Pizza Kitchen
- Website: https://palmpizzakitchen.com
- Location: Kigali, Rwanda
- Cuisine: Pizza, burgers, sides, drinks, meal combos
- Currency: Rwandan Francs (RWF)
- Service: Delivery across Kigali and pickup
- Typical delivery time: 30–40 minutes
- Typical hours: 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM daily (confirm on site)

## Contact

- Email: info@palmpizzakitchen.com
- Contact page: https://palmpizzakitchen.com/contact/
- Order online: https://palmpizzakitchen.com/pizzas/

## Ordering

1. Browse menu categories (pizzas, burgers, sides, drinks, combos).
2. Open a product page for details, sizes (when offered), and photos.
3. Add items to cart.
4. Checkout with name, phone, email, and delivery address in Kigali.
5. Pay online (mobile money / card where available).

## FAQ (summary)

- **Do you deliver in Kigali?** Yes — enter your address at checkout to confirm coverage.
- **Neighborhoods:** Central Kigali including Remera, Kimironko, Kacyiru, and nearby areas.
- **Payment:** Secure online checkout; mobile money and card options on the payment page.
- **Customize pizza:** Choose size on product pages where sizes are enabled; add notes at checkout.

## Machine-readable data

- Sitemap: https://palmpizzakitchen.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://palmpizzakitchen.com/robots.txt
- Live menu API (JSON): https://backend.palmpizzakitchen.com/api/menu
- Schema.org JSON-LD is embedded on home, product, FAQ, about, and contact pages.

## Do not index

Admin panel (/admin/), cart, checkout, account, and payment return URLs are private and blocked in robots.txt.
